mmrm_cross_package_validation_rule.description: Scope, package separation, analysis-row identity rule and numerical tolerances for cross-package validation of the primary Week 24 ACTOT MMRM contrasts.

mmrm_cross_package_reconstruction.description: Independent reconstruction of the observed-data ACTOT analysis rows and MMRM using nlme::gls with corSymm plus varIdent and independently constructed Week 24 contrasts.

mmrm_cross_package_validation_gate.description: Executable comparison of primary and independently reconstructed subject-visit analysis rows plus primary mmrm and independent nlme Week 24 contrast estimates and model-based standard errors against pre-specified tolerances.
